title: Abnormal Behavior
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents with abnormally elevated/irritable mood for ≥1 week, grandiosity, decreased need for sleep, pressured speech, flight of ideas, distractibility, increased goal-directed activity/psychomotor agitation, and risky behaviors (spending, sexual indiscretions). Manic episode = marked functional impairment. Bipolar I = at least one manic episode (depression not required for diagnosis, though most have both). Must rule out: substance-induced (stimulants, steroids), medical (hyperthyroidism, Cushing's, CNS lesion, delirium). Treatment: acute mania — mood stabilizer (lithium — gold standard, valproate, carbamazepine) + atypical antipsychotic (olanzapine, risperidone, quetiapine). Lithium requires monitoring (levels 0.6-1.2, renal, thyroid). For severe/psychotic → hospitalization. Long-term: mood stabilizer maintenance, psychotherapy. Screen for suicide risk.
chief_complaint: Elevated mood, decreased sleep, pressured speech, grandiosity

stacks.label: Lithium / Valproate
stacks.finding: Gold standard mood stabilizer. Monitor levels.
